problems: Page budget: the Caliphate dossier used 6 pages against a budget of 5 (the Taifa article was added to date the 1009-1026 losses); Leon used 9 and Castile 9, within budget. 19 distinct pages in all, since Abd al-Rahman III and Almanzor are shared by the Caliphate and Leon, and Ferdinand I, Alfonso VI and Alfonso VII by Leon and Castile.

The Caliphate_of_C%C3%B3rdoba page returned only a restructuring banner; the unaccented URL returned the article under the title 'Umayyad state of Córdoba'. The Almanzor fetch covered only to about 990.

Union passes between Leon and Castile follow Cliopatria's allocation (Castile row 1046-1065, 1072-1125, 1139-1168; León row 1126-1138). The Leon and Castile dossiers carry mirrored gain/loss events (1046 and 1139 at confidence 1); neighbours use kingdom-of-leon for 'León-Castile' events in the same years (taifa-of-badajoz 1055 and 1064, almoravid-dynasty 1094, almohad-caliphate 1188-1202), while Castile carries the matching land. The reviewer should reconcile the counterparts or decide to hold the union years in one dossier.

almohad-caliphate: 1195 gain names kingdom-of-leon but Alarcos was Castilian; 1216 loss names kingdom-of-castile with no matching Castile event; no 1230 loss to Leon for Mérida and Badajoz. almoravid-dynasty has no 1102 gain from Castile (Valencia). kingdom-of-navarre has no 1186 loss to Castile.
kingdom-of-pamplona has Sancho III holding León 1033-1035 (gains from and loss to kingdom-of-leon); no page opened here confirms it and the Leon dossier draws the 1010 shape unchanged to 1037.

idrisids ends 974 into caliphate-of-cordoba and has no 951 Tangier loss; the Caliphate dossier draws northern Morocco as a vassal tint to 1015 (vassal_end at confidence 1, a bridge). fatimid-caliphate has no 979 Ceuta event.

kingdom-of-galicia (another part) will overlap Leon 914-921 unless it ends at 914: the Leon and Asturias pages give 914 for Galicia joining León, Cliopatria 922. county-of-portugal starts 1096 (counterpart kingdom-of-galicia) while the Alfonso VI page disputes the date and Cliopatria drops the Portuguese lands from Castile in 1111.

Union end date differs across pages: 10 December 1230 (Leon page), 23 September 1230 (Kingdom of Castile infobox), 11 December 1230 (Ferdinand III page). Dossiers use 1230/12; Cliopatria ends both rows in 1235.

Cliopatria quirks: the 'Kingdom of Asturias' row 911-925 is really the Burgos/La Rioja/Cantabria land (treated as Leonese); the Caliphate row runs to 1071 though the Caliphate ended 30 November 1031 (the 1034 and 1066 shapes are marked wrong and belong to taifa-of-cordoba and Seville); the 980, 990 and 1010 Caliphate shapes include Morocco and Algeria as direct land and were corrected to Iberia plus Ceuta and Tangier with a vassal tint.

Start years differ from Cliopatria: Leon 910 (Cliopatria 911), Caliphate 929 (Cliopatria 936, three new keyframes 929, 930, 932), Castile 931 (Cliopatria 961, new keyframe castile_931). Rulers omitted for Leon and Castile.
